**NTRT gap brief — Thursday, 12 November 2026**

**Mode B — screener fallback.** TradingView public scanner; the ntrt backend was unreachable (`GET /health` → HTTP 000). Snapshot 09:04 ET, 26 min before the open.

**TL;DR**

- The tape is risk-off and AI-led: **693 names gapped 3% or more** pre-market (196 up, 497 down), but only **21 clear the actionable gate** (16 down, 5 up).
- **The %ADV reality check: 113 of 693 names cleared 5% of 30-day ADV**, and only 21 cleared all three legs (gap, 5% of ADV, $200M cap at the print) —
- read this screen as 21 tradeable names, not 693.
- **NVDA -9.3% is the name that matters**: the WSJ reports its board is preparing to oust CEO
Jensen Huang, and the AI complex sold off with it (CRWV -9.4%, NBIS -14.3%, SNDK -6.3%).

**Market backdrop**

- **Futures:** S&P 500 futures 7,586.75 (-0.70%), Nasdaq-100 futures 28,110.25 (-1.27%), Dow
futures 52,359.00 (-0.42%) — a tech-led pullback with the Dow cushioned.

- **The driver is Nvidia's leadership, not the economy.** After WSJ and New York Times reports
on CEO Jensen Huang's personal conduct and a possible board ouster, NVDA fell 7-8% pre-market; it has lost about $300B of value since the board opened its investigation.

- **Rates:** the 10-year Treasury yield sits at 5.00% (+1bp) after the hot October CPI; markets
price roughly an 84-91% chance of a Fed hike in December, with Daly, Schmid and Williams speaking today and a 30-year bond auction at 18:00.

- **Data:** initial jobless claims rose 9,000 to 200,000 for the week ended Nov 7 (consensus
195,000) — a firming labour market, not a weakening one.

- **Oil is falling:** Brent -1.23% to $91.62, WTI -1.13% to $85.55, cushioning the energy
complex even as the AI trade breaks.

- **A second AI overhang:** voters in 10 states backed data-centre restrictions after the midterms;
UBS estimates ~30% of expected 2028 US data-centre capacity additions are at risk.

**Flags**

- **FRMI +9.9% → -5.0%** — the actionable table's print faded hard in the 20 minutes after the pull: +9.9% at 09:04, +1.1% at 09:12, -5.0% at the 09:24 delta pull.
- A 15-point round trip on a book that was printing 9.7M shares at 09:04; do not treat the +9.9% row as the current price.
- **MDU +10.3% → +2.4%** —
- the wider-screen print faded below the 3% threshold and the name dropped out of the 09:24 delta pull entirely (700 shares at the re-check, 0.01% of ADV).
- The Freedom Broker upgrade was the driver; the pre-market book never held it.
- **RZLV -4.5%** — absent from the 09:24 delta pull and re-checked at -3.7% a minute later, i.e. it crossed back and forth across the 3% line.
- Its `Why` cell is blank: no catalyst could be confirmed.
- **NBIS -14.3% → -19.4%, CRWV -9.4% → -14.4%, TE -11.3% → -15.0%, SES -9.8% → -13.3%** — the neocloud and AI-supply-chain complex kept selling into the delta pull;
- four published names moved 3 points or more.
- **BRUN -19.4% on +496% revenue growth** — the move contradicts the fundamental:
- Q3 revenue $39.9M (+496% YoY) and total contracted revenue $2.7B, and the stock is down 19% on 143,093 shares (3.8% of ADV). Thin book, not a verdict on the quarter.
- **EROC -10.9% and NIQ -10.7%** — both moved the wrong way on good news (ERock's first profitable quarter, revenue ~4x q/q;
- NIQ's first GAAP EPS since IPO with FY26 guidance raised) on 48,081 and 23,614 shares respectively.
- **SMHI -4.4% on 6,711 shares (5.3% of ADV)** — a genuinely thin book:
- the print clears the 5% ADV leg by 0.3 of a point, and at $9.17 the whole session traded a few hundred board lots.
- **PARA's market cap is not a number you can trust** —
- the screener's `market_cap_basic` of $47,097 implies 656,000 shares, yet 376.6M shares traded pre-market and the print-time cap computes to $84K.
- The share count behind the $200M test is stale for this name; PARA is below the floor on any reading, but the cap itself is noise.
- **%ADV is distorted on the sub-floor names** — PARA 2,500% of ADV, VWAV 9,384%, ICMB 8,904%, POAS 5,271%, PLCE 1,089%. These are turnover prints on tiny books, not institutional flow.
- **NVDA -9.3% → -10.4%** — the gap deepened after the pull, on 45.3M pre-market shares at the delta pull. This is the day's driver, not a single-name story.
- **Six published names have no confirmed catalyst** — HYMC, RZLV, SMHI in the actionable table and FTK, CNCK, SHAZ in the wider screen.
- Their `Why` cells are blank and their CSV `catalyst` cells are empty, which means "not found", not "there wasn't one".
- **Five wider-screen gaps are quotes, not markets** —
- MDU +10.3% on 200 shares (0.011% of ADV), EZPW +8.8% on 100 shares (0.013%), FTK +9.7% on 200 shares (0.054%), FA +6.7% on 1,450 shares (0.070%), CNCK +9.4% on 100 shares (0.206%).
- Their %ADV cells round to 0.0-0.2 and they are all `noise: true` in the CSV.

**Method, source health & caveats**

- **Primary source:** TradingView public scanner, `POST https://scanner.tradingview.com/america/scan`, two pulls (gainers `premarket_change` in [3,1000] desc, losers in [-1000,-3]
- asc), `type: stock`, `exchange != OTC`, **no market-cap filter in the request**, `range` [0,2000]. Both pulls were COMPLETE: 196/196 and 497/497 rows against `totalCount`.
- The row key is the bare ticker (`d[0]`), never the venue-prefixed `s`.

- **ntrt backend:** `GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/health` → HTTP 000 (connection refused). The brief
is Mode B, the screener fallback, and every number here comes from that pull.

- **Pre-open tape: short (47 rows).** Cron #92's 08:30 ET checkpoint is far smaller than a
- movers-sorted snapshot and covers only a fraction of the screen, so it was not treated as the day's screen; every catalyst was sourced by an independent news search instead.
- The tape's own numbers are also a second opinion, not the price of record — the screener's number is published.

- **Importance measure:** `premarket_volume / average_volume_30d_calc`, published as % of 30-day
ADV. `average_volume_30d_calc` is a daily proxy, not an intraday one.

- **Market cap is measured AT THE PRE-MARKET PRINT** (share count recovered as
- `market_cap_basic / prev_close`, multiplied by the print) and the $200M floor is tested against that number, so the gate, the cap cell and the published price describe the same instant.
- `prev_close` is derived as `premarket_close / (1 + premarket_change/100)`, never read from the screener's `close` column, which carries the live intraday price once the session is open.

- **Delta pull at 09:24 ET** (about six minutes before the open, both sides complete: 195/195 and
572/572) was used for movement flags only — it never changes a published number. The tables above carry the 09:04 ET pull.

- **What could not be verified:** six published names (HYMC, RZLV, SMHI, FTK, CNCK, SHAZ) had no
- catalyst confirmable from a named source, so their `Why` cell is blank and their CSV `catalyst` cell is empty — a blank means "not found", not "there wasn't one".
- The market cap on PARA is not trustworthy at all (see Flags).
- Yahoo's pre-market tape was not used for any price: it carries no pre-market volume and goes stale on thin names.

- The CSV companion carries all 693 names at 3% or more, including the sub-floor ones and
- every name the tables above do not publish;
- a row outside the published set carries `not published (not checked)` in its `catalyst` column, and a watchlist row carries `watchlist (not checked)`.
